Author: T3chnicalD3ath Inc.
Name: Hunter v2
Description:
Automatically hunts mobs to collect specific items. Teleports to the right zone, mounts and flies to spawn points, engages and chains kills, tracks inventory progress live, and returns home when every enabled item is complete.

Organise items into hunt lists, import ingredient lists from Artisan (only ingredients that drop from mobs in the database are added), and edit the mob database in game.

Requires vnavmesh, Rotation Solver Reborn and Lifestream.
Punchline: Automatically hunt mobs for specific items

Author: T3chnicalD3ath Inc.
Name: Party Monitor
Description:
Monitors your party and reports changes. Tracks members joining and leaving, can look up encounter logs, and optionally relays party activity to a Discord channel.

Discord and FFLogs integration are optional and require you to supply your own credentials in the plugin settings. No credentials are bundled with the plugin.

Author: T3chnicalD3ath Inc.
Name: Party Recruitment Helper
Description: A plugin that helps manage Party Finder recruitment configurations. Save preset slot layouts and automatically reapply them when party members leave, eliminating the need to manually reconfigure slots repeatedly.
Punchline: Save and auto-restore Party Finder slot configurations

Author: pohky (fork maintained by T3chnicalD3ath Inc.)
Name: Teleporter
Description:
Adds Chat Commands to Teleport to Aetherytes or Areas by Name.
e.g. /tp Quarrymill or /tpm South Shroud
Supports setting up an Alias for Aetherytes to be used with Teleporter Commands
e.g. /tp home instead of /tp Estate Hall (Free Company)

This is an unofficial fork of TeleporterPlugin by pohky, rebuilt to keep pace with current Dalamud API levels. All original credit goes to pohky.

Original project: https://github.com/pohky/TeleporterPlugin
Changelog: Unofficial fork rebuilt for the current Dalamud API level.
